messages:
Maria: Customer on Private VPC seeing intermittent 401s and spikes of 429s during traffic bursts. They report billing overages from retry storms. Envoy MGW + k8s ingress (nginx) in front of our private gateway.
Ben: Which error is happening first — 401 auth failures or 429 rate-limits?
Maria: Customer says auth OK initially, then a bunch of 429s, then some 401s on retries. Timestamp window: 2025-11-04T14:03:00Z -> ~14:07.
Kevin: Sounds like token bucket mismatch between k8s ingress rate limiting and our gateway. Ingress allows a larger burst so upstream sees a concentrated burst and exhausts downstream tokens -> 429s, clients retry -> auth tokens expire/cycle -> 401s.
Ashley: Repro steps I used locally: in their cluster image, `kubectl port-forward svc/ingress-nginx 8080:80` then `ab -n 200 -c 50 http://localhost:8080/v1/chat` produced 50-60% 429s within first 30s.
Ashley: Quick commands I ran: `kubectl get configmap ingress-nginx-controller -o yaml` and `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-mgw -c gateway --since=5m` showed a flood of `rate_limited` entries.
Ben: Can you paste the ingress rate-limit config? values.yaml?
Ashley: They had `rate-limit: |\n  limit: 100r/s\n  burst: 100` for nginx, while our gateway token-bucket is `rate: 20r/s burst: 20`. So ingress let them accumulate a high concurrency window.
support-bot: Alert: rate_limit_service.qps=740, token_bucket_drops=612, 429_rate=0.31 in last 5m (svc:redwood-mgw-private).
Kevin: That explains it. When the gateway drops, client SDK retries almost immediately. The retry then hits auth token TTLs (short-lived) and flips some to 401. Also retries amplify billing counts.
Maria: Customer also attached cURL sample that shows auth header present: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -v ...` then 429 body: `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"retry_after\":1}`.
Ben: Short-term mitigation: request they lower ingress burst to match gateway, or increase gateway bucket temporarily. Long-term: surface backpressure to ingress (proxy-level rate control) or make gateway return `Retry-After` and have SDK backoff.
Kevin: Suggested Envoy rate-limit filter tweak (on gateway side) to smooth bursts: `token_bucket{ max_tokens: 200, tokens_per_fill: 10, fill_interval: 100ms }` — this gives leaky fill instead of a hard burst.
Ashley: Also suggest disabling aggressive client retries for this customer (set exponential backoff with jitter). I sent sample SDK config to customer.
Maria: Action items: 1) Sent config diff to customer to reduce ingress burst to 40. 2) Rolled a temporary gateway rate tweak for their cluster to `burst:50 rate:30` for 30 minutes and monitoring. 3) Engineering follow-up to add a private deployment doc section on coordinating k8s ingress and gateway token buckets.
Ben: Add a runbook note: check `token_bucket_drops`, `rls_retries`, and `auth_fail_after_retry` metrics. Also check k8s HPA scaling if ingress is queuing bursts.
Kevin: For the doc, include example `nginx` snippet to cap burst: `limit_req zone=one burst=40 nodelay;` and an Envoy snippet for token bucket config.
Maria: Customer confirmed fewer 429s after ingress changes, billing spike reduced. Will keep monitoring for 24h. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 6h to check metrics and update thread.
